verdict.rationale: Terraform is itself an official CLI: the probe confirms the documented CLI, and the docs cover agent-friendly commands. These include plan/apply with -out plan files and -auto-approve for non-interactive runs, show -json for machine-readable plan and state, and a streaming -json UI for long-running commands. Community users corroborate hands-on CLI use (init workflows, execution plans). Missing for 10: independent evidence of AI agents driving the CLI, and AI-specific guidance for CLI use.
